notes.title: Free mod (Episode 7) under developement
notes.notes:
Dear players,


After some discussions on the forums, I decided to begin the development of a last episode, Episode 7 ("Whisper of the Ash"). It should be a bit longer than episode 5. I have no idea how long it will take, since it will be done on my free time. 

This way you will be able to have the end of the heroin story. ;-)

It will be free and automatically added to the game when it's done.

( If you want to support the project, you can subscribe to my Patreon : https://www.patreon.com/seaauthor )

Cheers,
Clara

notes.title: Winter Is Coming: Winter Voices Get A Demo
notes.notes:
Alright, I want you lot to listen up. I’ve just noticed that indie RPG Winter Voices now has a demo available that you can either grab on the official site or using Steam. I don’t want you lot to run off and download it, because I’m positive that most of you would enjoy it about as much as having having smoke rings puffed in your face. notes.title: New Release - Winter Voices Episode 4: Amethyst Rivers
notes.notes:
The fifth chapter of Winter Voices is now available on Steam.

As you descend the mountain on the road to the capital, your vision clears little by little. For the first time, you are able to face your past, as well as your future. What do they have in store for you?

notes.title: Snow Business: Winter Voices Ep. 1 & 2 Out
notes.notes:
Episodes 1 and 2 of startlingly ambitious indie RPG Winter Voices have been released, though they’re technically episodes 2 & 3 since episode 0, Avalanche, is a standalone purchase in itself. You can get any of the episodes from Steam or from the Winter Voices site. I reviewed Avalanche here, and despite its crippling flaws it managed to be one of my favourite indie games of 2010. I’m head over heels in love with Beyond the Pillars, devs of Winter Voices, and what they’re trying to do. A video tour of the studio with lots of excitable chatter from the developers follows…
(more…)

notes.title: Winter Voices Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to Winter Voice have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:
  • Added the final dialogs / conclusion of the Seid (normal path), in the battle against The Man.
  • The "secret memory battle" in the village is no longer required to continue further into the game.
  • Achievements : "Perfect battles" and "Perfect volva battles" should now be working in the prologue.
  • The "15 turns" memories have been changed to "10 turns" or "position" objectives, making them easier and less boring.
  • All other "15 turns" battles have seen their objective modified to make them less boring (but not necessarily easier)
  • THE MOURNING battle has been totally revamped. This battle, while less boring than before, was still not fun at all. We think it is now both more fun and more respectful with the idea of the battle. Please let us know what you think about it !

notes.title: New Release - Winter Voices Prologue: Avalanche
notes.notes:
Winter Voices Prologue: Avalanche is now available on Steam!

Winter Voices Prologue: Avalanche is the first episode of 7 in a dramatic solo role playing game. Winter Voices is a beautifully drawn RPG that takes the player on a long journey to find answers. A unique adventure, a stunning scenario to discover in one season!
